# Data model

PostgreSQL in production (JSONB, tsvector GIN indexes, pgvector HNSW — added by migrations 0002/0005), SQLite in development. Schema changes are Alembic migrations in `database/migrations/versions`. Every case-scoped row carries `organization_id` and `case_id`; every repository query filters on both.

## `agent_runs`

| Column | Type | Null | Key / default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | VARCHAR(24) | no | indexed |
| `case_id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | → cases.id indexed |
| `organization_id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | → organizations.id indexed |
| `user_id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | → users.id |
| `thread_id` | VARCHAR(36) | yes |  |
| `goal` | TEXT | no |  |
| `intent` | VARCHAR(20) | yes |  |
| `status` | VARCHAR(10) | no |  |
| `plan` | JSON | no |  |
| `result` | JSON | yes |  |
| `engine` | VARCHAR(60) | no |  |
| `steps` | INTEGER | no |  |
| `tool_calls` | INTEGER | no |  |
| `replans` | INTEGER | no |  |
| `tokens` | INTEGER | no |  |
| `latency_ms` | INTEGER | yes |  |
| `error` | VARCHAR(300) | yes |  |
| `finished_at` | DATETIME | yes |  |
| `id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | PK |

* CHECK `ck_run_status`: `status IN ('queued','running','completed','partial','refused','failed')`
* FK (case_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

## `conflict_checks`

Conflict-of-interest check for one client request, run before the advocate sees the matter summary. Only names are disclosed for checking; automated hits reference the advocate's own firm's matters by reference number only. The client never learns why a request was declined.

| Column | Type | Null | Key / default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connection_id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | → connections.id unique |
| `organization_id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | indexed |
| `names_checked` | JSON | no |  |
| `automated_hits` | JSON | no |  |
| `status` | VARCHAR(16) | no |  |
| `decided_by` | VARCHAR(36) | yes | → users.id |
| `decided_at` | DATETIME | yes |  |
| `note` | VARCHAR(1000) | no |  |
| `id` | VARCHAR(36) | no | PK |
| `created_at` | DATETIME | no |  |

* CHECK `ck_conflict_status`: `status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW','CLEARED','CONFLICT')`
* UNIQUE `` (connection_id)
* FK (connection_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
